description: This file defines public APIs for Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) in PyTorch, including enums, data classes, and class definitions related to sharding strategies, prefetching, mixed precision, CPU offloading, and state dictionary configurations.

classes.name: ShardingStrategy
classes.description: Enum specifying sharding strategies for distributed training in FSDP.

classes.name: BackwardPrefetch
classes.description: Enum configuring explicit backward prefetching to improve throughput.

classes.name: MixedPrecision
classes.description: Data class configuring FSDP-native mixed precision training.

classes.name: CPUOffload
classes.description: Data class configuring CPU offloading options.

classes.name: StateDictType
classes.description: Enum indicating the type of state_dict being processed by FSDP.

classes.name: StateDictConfig
classes.description: Base class for state_dict configuration classes.

classes.name: FullStateDictConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for full state dicts, supporting offloading and rank0_only options.

classes.name: LocalStateDictConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for local sharded, flattened parameters.

classes.name: ShardedStateDictConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for sharded, unflattened parameters, with option for DTensor or ShardedTensor.

classes.name: OptimStateDictConfig
classes.description: Base class for optimizer state dict configurations.

classes.name: FullOptimStateDictConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for full optimizer state dicts, supporting rank0_only.

classes.name: LocalOptimStateDictConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for local optimizer state dicts with CPU offloading.

classes.name: ShardedOptimStateDictConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for sharded optimizer state dicts, with option for DTensor or ShardedTensor.

classes.name: StateDictSettings
classes.description: Class encapsulating the state dict type and associated configurations.
